TASK-020.title: Remove agency compatibility shims
TASK-020.summary: Complete the agency concept-root pilot lifecycle by removing deprecated agency old-path re-export shims after validated planning, updating remaining internal references to the source-root owner, and preserving public package or adapter behavior.

goal.outcome: Agency no longer depends on old layer-first compatibility shim files, while package/public behavior and adapter behavior remain unchanged.
acceptance: Remove the deprecated re-export-only agency compatibility shims at src/domain/agency/types.ts, src/application/agency.ts, and src/application/tools/agency.ts, or replace them only with explicitly justified non-source artifacts if deletion is blocked by validation.
Prove no package source, adapters, tests, or package smoke paths import the old agency shim paths after cleanup.
Preserve public commands, package entrypoints, adapter schemas/tool behavior, direct Node execution, package loading, and product behavior.
Update TASK-015-era shim/parity tests and package smoke assertions so they prove cleanup rather than shim equivalence.
Update file-structure KB/diagram to mark agency shim cleanup validated and keep non-agency concept roots deferred until cleanup task-close evidence exists.
Do not move any non-agency concept root or start audit/build/validation/session/roadmap/state/project migration in this task.
non_goals: Do not move audit, build, validation, session, state, roadmap, project, knowledge, gateway, GC, adapters, UI, or skills into concept roots.
Do not change public commands, tool schemas, package entrypoints, package metadata, or product behavior.
Do not select or implement the second concept-root migration boundary.
Do not remove or rewrite src/agency/** owner modules except where tests/imports require cleanup parity.
verification: node --experimental-strip-types ./tests/tasks/TASK-015/agency-source-root.test.mjs or successor TASK-specific cleanup test

delta.desired: Deprecated agency shim files are removed or explicitly blocked with validation evidence, with all package/public behavior unchanged.
delta.current: Agency source-root owner files are validated, but old layer-first agency paths remain as deprecated re-export-only shims.
delta.closure: Implementation build and validation prove shim cleanup, updated tests/KB/diagram, and no non-agency source migration.
